output.reason: The evidence names the subject and the change: port-forward (util/kube/portforwarder.go) and pod exec (server/application/terminal.go) now use WebSocket instead of SPDY [ev-44a03a4444c2] [ev-06320e039a7f] [ev-f9fcb1f92188]. The only effect it describes is that `argocd admin dashboard` stops failing with "Upgrade request required" when the kube-apiserver sits behind an L7 proxy that doesn't support SPDY [ev-bd2c4bad2901] [ev-41b489015f22]. It doesn't say what happens to an environment whose operator does nothing. It never says whether SPDY remains as a fallback, or whether exec and port-forward stop working against clusters older than the Kubernetes versions the issue mentions (v1.29 for exec, v1.30 for port-forward). The PR description just says "replaced spdy with websocket", and the actual diff or fallback behaviour isn't shown, so the consequence can't be written down without guessing.
